strings.help.title: How to use
strings.help.body:
① Select Source, Branch, Target System, Subtarget, and Target Profile in order;all values must come from the same Catalog
② Select the needed plugins;grey means unavailable in the current Catalog. Recommended and Defconfig decisions are recorded in the build log
③ Wait until Target and menuconfig finish loading, then enter firmware settings and submit the Issue;JSON, .config, and config.buildinfo can also be loaded
④ When Actions finishes, download each timestamped original .img.gz directly. CONFIG, BUILD-LOGS, OPTIONAL-PACKAGES, and FIRMWARE-OTHER contain supporting files. Firmware/configs stay 60 days and logs 60 days
⑤ First flash normally uses factory;sysupgrade is only for a compatible device and partition layout. If unsure, do not flash
strings.lanip.label: Admin login address (LAN IP, editable)
strings.lanip.hint: After flashing, open this address in a browser to reach the admin UI; the change only affects cloud builds — the local "Download .config" does not carry address settings
strings.lanip.invalid: The admin address must be a private IPv4 (e.g. 192.168.1.1); reset to default
strings.login.pw.none: none (set one right after first login)
strings.login.pw.password: initial password is 'password' (change it after login)
strings.rootpw.label: Initial password (optional, empty = source default)
strings.rootpw.public: ⚠️ Submitted content is public; the password will be public!
strings.rootpw.hint: Temporary login password; change it immediately after flashing. (Use @empty with lede to clear the default password.)
strings.rootpw.invalid: Initial password allows only 4-32 letters/digits and @#%^&*_+=.,:!?- symbols; cleared

strings.devpkg.title: All packages (developer)
strings.devpkg.hint: Operates raw CONFIG_PACKAGE symbols: tick = build in (=y), untick a builtin = remove; type at least 2 characters to search (e.g. iptables-mod), 200 results max; at your own risk
strings.devpkg.empty: Type at least 2 characters to search; this device has {n} packages in total
strings.devpkg.more: {n} more results hidden — keep typing to narrow down
strings.warn.docker: ⚠️ Container plugins are resource-hungry: ≥512MB free RAM and external USB storage recommended; on 128MB-flash routers merely building them in eats lots of space, and running them can stall the device or run out of storage — tick with care
strings.pkgpage.title: Package Reference
strings.pkgpage.intro: The top half searches all {raw} raw packages for Developer mode; the bottom half lists {curated} curated plugins with purpose notes. Follow each raw-package row’s official-docs link for details.
strings.pkgpage.rawNote: Type at least 2 characters to search (e.g. iptables-mod, kmod-usb). Badges show package availability by source; ✓ means the source includes it by default. “Docs” opens the official OpenWrt package index (official-feed packages only); use “Search” for the rest.
strings.pkgpage.hint.start: {n} packages in total — type at least 2 characters to search
strings.pkgpage.hitMore: , showing the first 500 — keep typing to narrow down
strings.adv.grey.hint: Grey = packages this source does not offer; forcing them in very likely breaks the build — at your own risk
strings.adv.grey.confirm: Allow force-selecting greyed-out plugins? These packages do not exist in this source's repositories, and forcing them in breaks the build nine times out of ten; recommended only for users who know exactly what they are doing.

strings.warn.dnsmasqFull: ⚠️ This is the router’s only DNS/DHCP service. Removing it without adding basic dnsmasq leaves LAN clients without IP addresses or Internet access; many proxy plugins require the full build.
strings.warn.blockMount: ⚠️ Removing this disables automatic USB-drive mounting; it is safe to remove when you do not use USB storage.
